redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses a distinct material fact: revenue growth (K1), EBITDA performance (K2), net profit (K3), acquisition (K4), new cheese production launch (K5), debt increase (K6), segment revenue structure (K7), and revenue geography (K8). No unit is a subset or duplicate of another.

key_information_units.information: Revenue increased by 22.4% to MEUR 86,970 thousand (MEUR 87.0) in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows Revenue Q1 2024: 56,192; Q1 2025: 71,072; Q1 2026: 86,970 with change 22.4%. Text states 'revenue During Q1 2026 consolidated increased by 22.4%, compared to the same period last year and amounted to MEUR 87.0.'

key_information_units.information: EBITDA decreased by 50.2% to MEUR 3,003 thousand (MEUR 3.0) in Q1 2026, excluding preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5 related to the acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows EBITDA Q1 2024: 6,446; Q1 2025: 6,031; Q1 2026: 3,003 with change -50.2%. Text states 'In Q1 2026 EBITDA excludes preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5 related to the acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB.'

key_information_units.information: Net profit increased by 25.7% to MEUR 5,085 thousand (MEUR 5.1) in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows Net profit Q1 2024: 4,923; Q1 2025: 4,045; Q1 2026: 5,085 with change 25.7%. Text states 'In the first three months of 2026, the Group's net profit amounted to MEUR 5.1, which was 25.7% higher than in the same period of 2025.'

key_information_units.information: Acquired 100% shares of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB on 16 January 2026, adding canned milk and milk powder production facilities.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main events section states 'On 16 January 2026, Vilkyškių pieninė AB completed the transaction for the acquisition of shares of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB. 100% of the company’s shares were acquired.' Further details describe its two production facilities for canned milk and milk powder.

key_information_units.information: Commercial cheese production commenced at Baltic Dairy Board SIA's new factory in Bauska, Latvia, with planned annual production of 18 thousand tons and creation of over 100 jobs, exporting to more than 40 countries.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main events section states 'VILVI Group has started commercial cheese production in Latvia... factory will create more than 100 jobs, and the planned cheese production volumes will reach 18 thousand tons per year. These products will be exported to more than 40 countries worldwide.'

key_information_units.information: Net financial debt increased by 89.7% to MEUR 83,427 thousand (MEUR 83.4) in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows Net financial debt Q1 2024: 20,560; Q1 2025: 43,971; Q1 2026: 83,427 with change 89.7%.

key_information_units.information: Operating segment revenue shifted with canned milk contributing 14% of total revenue, dry milk products increasing by 126.9% to MEUR 24,659 thousand, cheese products decreasing by 28.8% to MEUR 37,641 thousand, and fresh milk products increasing by 73.4% to MEUR 12,748 thousand.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales revenue by operating segments table shows Q1 2026 values: Cheese 37,641; Fresh milk 12,748; Dry milk 24,659; Canned milk 11,923; with year-over-year changes of -28.8%, 73.4%, 126.9%, respectively. Picture text confirms segment percentages for Q1 2026: Cheese 43%, Canned milk 14%, Dry milk 28%, Fresh milk 15%.

key_information_units.information: Revenue geography shifted with Lithuania's share rising to 17% of total from 12%, European Union decreasing to 49% from 59%, and other countries increasing to 34% from 29%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales revenue by markets table shows Q1 2026 percentages derived from values: EU 42,518/86,970=48.9% (~49%); Lithuania 14,633/86,970=16.8% (~17%); Other countries 29,818/86,970=34.3% (~34%). Picture text confirms Q1 2026 percentages: EU 49%, Lithuania 17%, Other countries 34%.
